scripts.dev:all: bun run sync:public-env && bun scripts/dev.ts all
scripts.dev:mobile: bun run sync:public-env && bun scripts/dev.ts mobile
scripts.dev:admin: bun run sync:public-env && bun scripts/dev.ts admin
scripts.dev:backend: bun run sync:public-env && bun scripts/dev.ts backend
scripts.test: bun test scripts && bun run --filter @passenger/core test && bun run --filter @passenger/backend test
scripts.build:admin: bun run sync:public-env && bun run --filter @passenger/admin build
scripts.export:mobile: bun run sync:public-env && bun run --filter @passenger/mobile export:web
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
